summary: Agent terminals show a 36-column details sidebar when the pane is at least 120 columns wide, using the existing device-local visibility preference.

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: Uses the existing TUI-local agent_details preference. No shared schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: PTY fits the remaining pane and can narrow the shared grid for other attached writable viewers. Terminal passthrough keys are unchanged unless details explicitly have focus.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: Conversation Ctrl+D and terminal leader i toggle the shared preference. Leader d or click focuses terminal details; Esc or Tab returns to passthrough.

recovery.detail: Older clients ignore the additive local preference field.
